rules.title: Go 1.25 is no longer supported
rules.summary: The Go release policy supports a major release until two newer major releases exist. Go 1.25 support ended when Go 1.27 was released.

sources.title: Go release history and support policy

constraints: Keep go.mod, go.work, CI matrices, and container images on one supported Go release.
Check that every dependency's own go directive is compatible with the target toolchain.

steps.title: Raise the Go version
steps.instructions: Raise the reported `go` or `toolchain` line from Go 1.25 to a supported release (see the replacement), for example with `go get go@<version> toolchain@<version>`.

steps.title: Align other Go version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update CI setup-go versions, Dockerfile `golang:` images, and other go.mod or go.work files in the repository so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active toolchain is the intended release.
Build and test every package on the new release.
Catch problems the newer release reports.

rules.title: cloud.google.com/go/pubsub is deprecated
rules.summary: The latest cloud.google.com/go/pubsub module declares: "use cloud.google.com/go/pubsub/v2 instead. This version will be supported with bug fixes and security patches until December 31st, 2026. For migration, see https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-go/blob/main/pubsub/MIGRATING.md"

constraints: Keep go.mod and go.sum consistent: after the change no package should still require cloud.google.com/go/pubsub, directly or through a replace directive.
Check cloud.google.com/go/pubsub/v2 for API differences before switching; it may not be a drop-in replacement for every cloud.google.com/go/pubsub call.

steps.title: Replace the deprecated module
steps.instructions: Replace the cloud.google.com/go/pubsub requirement with cloud.google.com/go/pubsub/v2 (`go get cloud.google.com/go/pubsub/v2@latest`), then run `go mod tidy`.

steps.title: Migrate imports and calls
steps.instructions: Update imports and calls of cloud.google.com/go/pubsub in the reported files to cloud.google.com/go/pubsub/v2.

verification.purpose: Build and test every package without the deprecated module.

verification.command: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
verification.purpose: Confirm go.mod and go.sum are tidy after the replacement.
